name: Alex Okonkwo
demographic: 23-year-old in first full-time job, relocating for work, searching for a 1-bed or studio near transit.
goals: Browse and filter listings that fit commute + budget
Open a detail page and understand total cost (rent + fees)
Feel confident enough to save or inquire
pain_points: Unclear fee breakdowns and application costs
Filters that reset or don't stick
Dead-end pages with no next step

constraints.budget: entry-level salary; sensitive to deposits and broker fees
constraints.time: weeknights after work; wants results in under 15 minutes

voice: Straightforward and slightly nervous about money. Quotes specific UI moments. Asks 'what am I missing?' when something feels incomplete. Suggests competitor-inspired improvements for App A.
